note: Built-in baseline compiled into this wallet build. It mirrors the release set of signed safe-Core policy v3, whose signature verifies under the trusted key a6b89849cec9eab7 pinned in core_safety_policy.py. It is used when no signed remote policy has been accepted, and a remote policy may add or restrict entries but may never rehabilitate anything refused here. Identity is repository plus commit; a version string on its own never matches. The expiry carried by the signed policy is deliberately not mirrored: a built-in baseline that expires would leave a wallet with no policy at all.

releases.revocationReason: 2miners is not a trust source; superseded by the RavenProject-only Core trust root
